datasets.creator: jmuehlhans
datasets.title: Tuning Fork 440 Hz, Resonance Box
datasets.acquisition_description: Creator reports a mono tuning fork/resonance box recording with Arnold Esper K4 measurement microphone in an anechoic chamber. Commons supplies a shorter OGG derivative of the original 80.360 s recording.
limitations: Nominal fork label is not an independent calibrated physical frequency reference.
The ADC clock uncertainty and recording-room temperature are not supplied.
The retained audio is a lossy OGG derivative, decoded to PCM without resampling.
Windowed frequency estimates vary across the decay; do not force exact stationarity or interpret estimator-only uncertainty as total measurement uncertainty.

datasets.creator: Paul Pontius, NIST
datasets.title: NIST/ITL Statistical Reference Datasets: Pontius load-cell calibration
datasets.license: NIST data terms; US government work; acknowledgment required; see NIST-NOTICE.txt
datasets.model: deflection = B0 + B1 * load + B2 * load**2
datasets.transformation: Whitespace-delimited y,x rows parsed without numeric rescaling. Added 1-based observation index and run index; exact source decimal strings retained.
limitations: Original SI conversion factors are unavailable; never report N/m, metres or newtons for these values.
The certified fit checks numerical implementation, not independent physical stiffness accuracy.
Two increasing-load runs confound drift with load.
A quadratic response is required; a visually near-perfect linear R-squared does not establish sufficient calibration accuracy.

datasets.title: Data for: Development of a novel nickel-based metal force microsensor using bottom-up approach
datasets.source_reported_reference_instrument: Calibrated Megatron Elektronik KM1403 force transducer, 100 N range, 2.0357 mV/V
datasets.transformation: stiffness_si.csv preserves force strings and converts source displacement_mm to displacement_m by exact decimal division by 1000; point/branch retained. All downloaded source files are unchanged.
limitations: Source authors report calibrated force-reference instrumentation, but do not supply the calibration certificate or full reference/displacement uncertainty budget.
Loading and unloading are from the same specimen and source experiment, not independent laboratories or a new physical experiment run by InstrumentZero.
Regression standard errors are conditional on the statistical model and do not include missing instrument systematic uncertainty.
No independent physical stiffness certificate is provided; comparing the fitted slope against the paper using the same curve is numerical reproduction only.

Raw capacitance timestamps are unavailable; the source calibration applied explicit time-axis alignment, interpolation, trimming, and averaging. Unadjusted raw channels must not be treated as synchronized.

Primary article Sections 4.2-4.3 (PDF pages 8-9) report capacitance anomalies and out-of-plane rib deflection above about 3 N; source replay above that level is not permission to recommend new physical loading there.
The article explicitly identifies mechanical slack/backlash and calls for independent displacement sensing. Encoder readings cannot be assumed to equal true specimen deflection without uncertainty.
datasets.published_uncertainty_kind: conditional regression slope standard deviation; not full measurement uncertainty
